name: Odin Trade Token
description: Official institutional quantitative utility and profit-share token for Odin.trade by Sevinex Technologies. Features auto-deflationary burning, 20% trading profit rake, and tier-based strategy gating.

trustwallet_import_guide.step1: Open Trust Wallet on your phone (iOS / Android).
trustwallet_import_guide.step2: Tap the top-right filter icon (Manage Crypto) -> Tap the '+' button to add custom token.
trustwallet_import_guide.step5: Name: Odin Trade Token | Symbol: ODN | Decimals: 18
trustwallet_import_guide.step6: Tap 'Save' or 'Import'. ODN is now permanently visible in your Trust Wallet balance!
